parts.name: Root
parts.description: The picture and its fallback. It holds the status of the image, and it has no role of its own.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The root element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when the image starts to load, loads, or fails.

parts.name: Image
parts.description: The picture. It loads the image off the screen first, and it renders the `` once the image is there.

props.name: src
props.description: The address of the image. Without it, the fallback shows.

props.name: alt
props.description:
The text in place of the image. Give the name of the person or the thing. Give an empty
string when the name is beside the avatar already, thus a screen reader does not read it
twice.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The image element, once the image is on the screen. Use `bind:element` to read it.

parts.name: Fallback
parts.description: What shows in place of the image, while the image is not on the screen. `delay` holds it back while the image loads.

props.name: children
props.description: The content in place of the image, such as initials or an icon.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: delay
props.description:
The time in milliseconds before the fallback shows while the image loads. A fallback that
flashes before a fast image is noise: 300 or 600 hides it on a good connection. It shows at
once when the image fails, or when there is no image.

props.name: element
props.description: The fallback element, while it is on the screen. Use `bind:element` to read it.

dataAttributes.name: data-status
dataAttributes.description: `loading` or `error`: the fallback is not on the screen while the image is.
